'''''Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord''''' is an upcoming ten-episode animated series set to be released between [[April 6]] and [[May 4]], [[2026]]. Set during the [[Imperial Era]], a few short [[Standard year|years]] after [[Order 66]],<ref name="Teaser sw.com" /> it will follow the former [[Sith]] [[Maul]] as he rebuilds his criminal empire. The show was first announced at [[Celebration Japan (2025)|''Star Wars'' Celebration Japan]], during a panel celebrating the 20th anniversary of [[Lucasfilm Animation]].<ref name="Celeb Maul" /> ''Maul - Shadow Lord'' is created by [[Dave Filoni]], and developed by Filoni and [[Matt Michnovetz]], with [[Brad Rau]] as supervising director, and produced by [[Lucasfilm Animation]]. The series will feature a more stylized version of the animation style from the previous animated series.<ref name="Teaser sw.com" />

A five-issue prequel [[Star Wars comic books|comic miniseries]] titled ''[[Star Wars: Shadow of Maul]]'' written by [[Benjamin Percy]] was published beginning on [[March 4]], [[2026]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=articles/comics/star-wars-shadow-of-maul-prequel-comic-maul-shadow-lord-animated-series|text=The 'Star Wars: Shadow of Maul' Comic Series Establishes the World of the Upcoming Animated Show}}</ref>

==Development==
Reports of a [[Maul]]-focused animated series first emerged in late [[2021]].<ref name="Rumors">{{WebCite|url=https://www.cinelinx.com/movie-news/tv/new-star-wars-animated-series-to-focus-on-darth-mauls-shenanigans-exclusive|text=New Star Wars Animated Series to Focus on Darth Maul's Shenanigans | Exclusive|author=[[Jordan Maison]]|date=2021-11-01|archivedate=20250118200540}}</ref> On [[April 18]], [[2025]], at [[Celebration Japan (2025)|''Star Wars'' Celebration Japan]], ''Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord'' was officially announced at [[Lucasfilm Animation]]'s panel.<ref name="Swcom Maul" /> The series is produced by [[Athena Yvette Portillo]], the head writer is [[Matt Michnovetz]]<ref name="Celeb Maul" /> and it will star [[Sam Witwer]].<ref name="Swcom Maul" /> According to Witwer, he was first brought in on the series by [[Dave Filoni]] about a year prior to the announcement.<ref name="Celeb Maul" /> A trailer was shown to those in attendance at the panel suggested the series, while broadly following the animation style pioneered by ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', would have its own flourish.<ref name="Gizmodo Breakdown">{{WebCite|url=https://gizmodo.com/star-wars-maul-shadow-lord-trailer-description-celebration-japan-2000589924|text=''Maul: Shadow Lord'' Is ''Star Wars''{{'s}} Next Animated Series|author=Graves, Sabina|date=2025-04-18|archivedate=20250419181340}}</ref>

[[File:MaulStance-MaulShadowLord.png|thumb|left|300px|Footage of Maul was revealed within the twentieth anniversary of Lucasfilm Animation video.]]
The panel-exclusive trailer revealed the series would entail Maul striking against the criminal underworld as he rebuilds his power, confronting the [[Inquisitor]] [[Marrok|First Brother]] and a [[Eeko-Dio Daki|Vurk Jedi]], and taking on a new [[Twi'lek]] [[Devon Izara|apprentice]],<ref name="Gizmodo Breakdown" /> whom he believed would help him in his quest for vengeance after he received a [[Force vision]].<ref name="TrailerTwitter">{{Twitter|username=sw_holocron|url=status/1913133176693948464|name=''Star Wars'' Holocron|date=2025-04-18|quote=A new animated series MAUL: SHADOW LORD has been announced. A first trailer was shown and depicts Maul as he navigates life between the events of The Clone Wars and Rebels. The plot seems to focus on Maul training a new padawan after having a vision she can help him seek revenge.  The trailer shows Maul fight Marrok who says, "So it's true. You live.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/jSSpQ}}</ref> The trailer also featured a small crew still serving Maul,<ref name="Mandalorians">{{Twitter|username=HarrisHarrisev9|url=status/1913135709252186434|name=HarrisHarrisev9|date=2025-04-18|quote=That Shadow Lord trailer was incredible!! Ruthless Maul and his remaining Mandalorian crew in the SW underworld! He takes on a young Apprentice too!! Ends with him fighting an Inquisitor in top a moving speeder!  I'm SO HYPED! #SWCJ|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/5ffYD}}</ref> including the [[Mandalorian]] [[Rook Kast]].<ref name="RookKast">{{Twitter|username=z_kokonut|url=status/1913180839354974222|name=z_kokonut|date=2025-04-19|quote=Rook Kast is back in Maul Shadow Lord!! I'm glad to see her return. I remember the theories about her being the armourer in Mandalorian.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/rFEut}}</ref> Footage of Maul from ''Shadow Lord'' was publicly showcased in a tribute video made to celebrate twenty years of [[Lucasfilm Animation]].<ref name="LucasfilmAnimation">{{SWYouTube|MUc6CHQLEyg|Lucasfilm Animation 20th Anniversary}}</ref>

==Release and reception==
The official teaser trailer was released on [[January 22]], [[2026]]<ref name="Teaser sw.com" /> and a trailer was released on [[March 16]].<ref name="Trailer sw.com">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-maul-shadow-lord-trailer|text=Watch the Official Trailer for ''Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord''}}</ref> The series is expected to be released on [[Disney+]] between [[April 6]] and [[May 4]], 2026.<ref name="Teaser sw.com" />
